set.excerpt: Applicants must have an average equivalent to 85% or higher ... in each of the last three years of secondary education ... personal statement and two recommendation letters ... the average minimum requirement of 85% serves as a guideline ... may be higher. Mandatory subjects (Minimum Grade B): Engineering majors Math and Physics (physics completed by at least Grade 11); Business majors Math; Science majors (including Computer Science) Math and a Science subject. American Curriculum: minimum of 85% average in each of the last three years ... SAT Math score of 450 and above ... SAT Math is mandatory. British Curriculum: complete Year 13 ... five IGCSE/GCSE (O-Level) subjects with a minimum grade of 5 or B in each subject, and either three AS-Level subjects, or two A-level subjects with a minimum grade of B in each subject. IB: full IB Diploma with six subjects (excluding Islamic Education), at least three at Higher Level, minimum score of 24 points ... a guideline ... may be higher. General Secondary Curriculum (Thanaweya Ammah and Applied Technology): minimum of 85% average in each of the last three years. English: IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 4.5 (previously 80), TOEFL ITP 550. Architecture & Interior Design Math and a Science subject applicants to the majors of architecture, design management, and interior design should submit a portfolio. Engineering majors Math and Physics Applicants must have completed math within the final three years of secondary education. The physics science subjects must be completed by at least Grade 11, with preference given to Grade 12. IELTS Academic TOEFL iBT TOEFL iTP 6.5 4.5 (previously 80) 550 Only TOEFL and IELTS are accepted by the American University of Sharjah Other required documents for Transfer applicants: a minimum EmSAT Achieve English result of 1550
